package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	TeacherResponseTemplateCode = "teacher.response.v1"
	TeacherResponseSchemaCode   = "teacher.response.v1"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration     = errors.New("invalid teacher generation")
	ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable = errors.New("teacher generation unavailable")
	ErrTeacherGenerationConflict    = errors.New("teacher generation conflict")
	ErrTeacherGenerationNotFound    = errors.New("teacher generation not found")
)

// TeacherGenerationRequest is transient. None of its context snapshots may be
// persisted by Teacher Agent.
type TeacherGenerationRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string
	LanguageCode   string
	Teacher        PersonalTeacher
	Soul           TeacherSoul
	Plan           TeacherTeachingPlan
	Student        StudentContext
	Dialog         DialogRequestContext
	PromptContext  TeacherPromptDialogContext
	Lesson         *LessonTeachingContext
}

type TeacherGeneratedResponse struct {
	ExecutionID        string
	IdempotencyKey     string
	TemplateCode       string
	TemplateVersion    int
	ProviderCode       string
	ProviderModel      string
	LanguageCode       string
	ResponseSchemaCode string
	Body               string
	Cached             bool
	CreatedAt          time.Time
	ExpiresAt          time.Time
}

func NewTeacherGenerationRequest(input TeacherGenerationRequest) (TeacherGenerationRequest, error) {
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.LanguageCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.LanguageCode))
	plan, err := NewTeacherTeachingPlan(input.Plan)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	dialog, err := NewDialogRequestContext(input.Dialog)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	input.Plan = plan
	input.Dialog = dialog
	promptContext, err := NormalizeTeacherPromptDialogContext(input.PromptContext, dialog.SourceMessageID, dialog)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	input.PromptContext = promptContext
	if dialog.ContextType == LearningContextLesson {
		source := dialog.Messages[len(dialog.Messages)-1].LessonContext
		if input.Lesson == nil || source == nil {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		lesson, lessonErr := NormalizeLessonTeachingContext(*input.Lesson)
		if lessonErr != nil || lesson.LessonID != dialog.ContextID || lesson.Schema != source.Schema ||
			lesson.Mode != source.Mode || lesson.CourseID != source.CourseID || lesson.LessonID != source.LessonID ||
			lesson.ContentRevision != source.ContentRevision || lesson.SelectedText != source.SelectedText ||
			lesson.LearningPathID != source.LearningPathID || lesson.LearningPathItemID != source.LearningPathItemID || lesson.ContentDigest != source.ContentDigest {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		input.Lesson = &lesson
	} else if input.Lesson != nil {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	soul, err := NormalizeTeacherSoul(input.Soul)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	input.Soul = soul
	if input.Student.CodeContext != nil {
		codeContext, codeErr := NormalizeStudentLearningActionCodeContext(
			*input.Student.CodeContext, input.Student.StudentID, input.Student.LearningActionID, input.Student.TaskID,
		)
		if codeErr != nil || input.Student.ContextType == LearningContextGeneral || input.Student.ContextType == LearningContextLesson {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		input.Student.CodeContext = &codeContext
	}
	if input.Student.PracticeTask != nil {
		practice, practiceErr := NormalizePracticeTaskContext(
			*input.Student.PracticeTask, input.Student.StudentID, input.Student.ContextID,
		)
		if practiceErr != nil || (input.Student.ContextType != LearningContextPracticeTask && input.Student.ContextType != LearningContextProject) ||
			practice.TaskRevisionID != input.Student.TaskID {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		input.Student.PracticeTask = &practice
	}
	if input.Student.PracticeValidation != nil {
		if input.Student.PracticeTask == nil || input.Student.ContextType != LearningContextPracticeTask {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		validation, validationErr := NormalizePracticeTeacherValidationContext(
			*input.Student.PracticeValidation, *input.Student.PracticeTask, input.Student.LearningActionID,
		)
		if validationErr != nil || !validation.Available {
			return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
		}
		input.Student.PracticeValidation = &validation
	}
	if !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) || !validValue(input.LanguageCode, 16) ||
		input.Teacher.ID != dialog.PersonalTeacherID || input.Teacher.StudentID != dialog.StudentID ||
		input.Soul.PersonalTeacherID != input.Teacher.ID || input.Soul.StudentID != input.Teacher.StudentID ||
		input.Student.StudentID != dialog.StudentID || input.Student.LearningActionID != dialog.LearningActionID ||
		input.Student.ContextType != dialog.ContextType || input.Student.ContextID != dialog.ContextID {
		return TeacherGenerationRequest{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NewTeacherGeneratedResponse(input TeacherGeneratedResponse) (TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	input.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ExecutionID)
	input.IdempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(input.IdempotencyKey)
	input.TemplateCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.TemplateCode)
	input.ProviderCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderCode)
	input.ProviderModel = strings.TrimSpace(input.ProviderModel)
	input.LanguageCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.LanguageCode))
	input.ResponseSchemaCode = strings.TrimSpace(input.ResponseSchemaCode)
	body, err := NormalizeTeacherResponseBody(input.Body)
	if err != nil || !validUUID(input.ExecutionID) || !validUUID(input.IdempotencyKey) ||
		input.TemplateCode != TeacherResponseTemplateCode || input.TemplateVersion < 1 ||
		!validValue(input.ProviderCode, 64) || !validValue(input.ProviderModel, 128) ||
		!validValue(input.LanguageCode, 16) || input.ResponseSchemaCode != TeacherResponseSchemaCode ||
		input.CreatedAt.IsZero() || input.ExpiresAt.IsZero() || !input.ExpiresAt.After(input.CreatedAt) {
		return TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, ErrInvalidTeacherGeneration
	}
	input.Body = body
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.ExpiresAt = input.ExpiresAt.UTC()
	return input, nil
}
